title: Company address: DNS first, proof before publication
subtitle: P69 / ADR-0033. No inference proxy, domain purchase or free managed certificate. Public DNS ownership is required on every v2 tier.

groups.title: Review and approval - before resource writes
Apply - preserve existing service and unrelated configuration
Verify and publish - a failure leaves the previous recorded URL

nodes.title: 1 - One costed address plan
lines: DNS and Key Vault retail rates; issuer/provider charges remain separate and unknown when unpriced.
Installer summary or [[fingerprint]] approves effective inherited inputs; proposed decisions remain separate from applied state.

nodes.title: 2 - Establish DNS ownership
lines: Existing writable Azure public zone, or exact records for the external DNS provider.
Conditional write; bounded resolution wait. Authoritative-only DNS is insufficient.

nodes.title: 3 - Use a supplied certificate
lines: Uploaded PFX: private key, hostname and validity checked.
Key Vault: [[grant]] adds secret read to the gateway identity.
No password or certificate bytes in the plan or record.

nodes.title: 4 - Patch the gateway binding
lines: Proxy [[patch]] only; retain other entries and all service/network properties.
Basic/Standard: explicit old-host replacement. Premium: additional hosts.
Bounded update; scoped recovery before proof.

nodes.title: 5 - Prove the new address
lines: Normal trust + exact certificate pin + unauthenticated HTTP 401.
This proves routing/TLS, not an entitled model request.

nodes.title: 6 - Publish developer settings
lines: Generated profiles, onboarding mail and package copies updated.
Already-deployed workstations need the redistributed package.

notice: Accepted deferral to P74, not done: Basic v2 rejected the undelegated .test hostname with CustomHostnameOwnershipCheckFailed after authoritative DNS succeeded. Positive company-hostname TLS requires an owned, delegated domain.
